facts.explanation: Human spaceflight began with a small satellite and quickly moved to people orbiting Earth, walking in space and landing on the Moon. Later, reusable shuttles and a permanently crewed space station made living in orbit routine, and private companies began flying astronauts.

facts.label: Sputnik 1 launched
facts.description: First artificial satellite to orbit Earth.

facts.label: Yuri Gagarin orbits Earth
facts.description: First human in space, aboard Vostok 1.

facts.label: Valentina Tereshkova flies
facts.description: First woman in space, aboard Vostok 6.

facts.label: Apollo 11 lands on the Moon
facts.description: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walk on the Moon.

facts.label: First ISS module launched
facts.description: The Zarya module starts the International Space Station.

facts.label: ISS continuously crewed
facts.description: Expedition 1 arrives; people have lived aboard ever since.

facts.label: First commercial crew launch
facts.description: SpaceX Crew Dragon Demo-2 carries NASA astronauts to the ISS.
